stories.title: Ole Miss vs. LSU rivalry: 160 years of love, hate and the river’s edge
stories.summary: The LSU-Ole Miss rivalry is long, with two fanbases deeply intertwined. The line between love and hate is thin, and Lane Kiffin's return brings those memories to the surface.

stories.title: Sources: Jazz, George reach $157.5M extension
stories.summary: The Utah Jazz and guard Keyonte George have agreed to a five-year, $157.5 million contract extension, sources told ESPN.

stories.title: Vikings to start Wentz with Murray on the mend
stories.summary: Carson Wentz will be the Vikings' starting quarterback Sunday against the Bears while Kyler Murray continues to work his way back after suffering a concussion in the season opener.

stories.title: Burrow good to go, Stewart to debut for Bengals
stories.summary: Bengals QB Joe Burrow (back) was a full participant at Friday's practice and is set to start in Sunday's road affair against the Texans.

stories.title: Rams coach McVay: No more Australia trips 'ever again'
stories.summary: Rams coach Sean McVay is hoping to brush off his team's lackluster season-opening loss to the 49ers by not thinking about Australia -- for a very long time.
